title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in Preview chat and History
summary: The roadmap facts, credit estimates, billing qualifications and documented allocation controls are supported. Add a qualification that Power Platform allocations cease to apply where a Microsoft 365 resource-based spending policy manages the environment; another Microsoft page documents that exception.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans maker cost visibility in Preview and agent history for testing and historical runs.
claims.quote: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run.

claims.claim: Administrators can control who builds Microsoft Copilot harness agents through existing permissions.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot harness doesn't have its own maker-access setting. To control who can create agents, use your existing Copilot Studio and environment permissions.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2026, not a committed availability date.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "September CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) is the only cloud listed in the roadmap record.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap platform is Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-09-15T23:00:36.
The roadmap item has no more-info link.
claims.quote: "moreInfoLink": null

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap description does not specify which agent harnesses it covers.
claims.quote: Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

claims.claim: The September 2026 target month has passed as of the November 17, 2026 run while the record remains In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "targetDate": "September CY2026"

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Preview chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits for the current test session.
claims.quote: The **Preview** chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits used during the current test session. It updates as you interact with the agent.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Preview tab's History view has a Credits used column for past conversations.
claims.quote:
Select **History** in the preview header to open the history view.
**Credits used** | The estimated Copilot Credits used during the session.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify its documented credit displays as the shipped implementation of roadmap item 571194.
claims.quote: Searched: "571194" "Preview"; Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History licensing price display rollout release channel 571194. Opened Preview overview, Preview history and Understand estimated credit usage; none identifies the roadmap item.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Preview and Evaluate credit figures are near-real-time approximations rather than final billing figures.
claims.quote: The estimates in **Preview** and **Evaluate** are near-real-time approximations that give you immediate visibility into how many credits an action is likely to consume, without waiting for the full billing pipeline to complete.

claims.claim: Monitor updates a few times a day.
claims.quote: The view in **Monitor** is updated a few times a day

claims.claim: Monitor shows accurate credit consumption for events processed so far.
claims.quote: shows the accurate number of credits consumed for all events processed up to that point.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Monitor is the source of truth for credit consumption and reflects what will be billed for the selected period.
claims.quote: This value reflects the number of Copilot Credits that will be billed for the selected period and serves as the source of truth for credit consumption reporting.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Monitor is authoritative for the complete period only once all its activities have been processed.
claims.quote: the number might not reflect the entire bill until all activities for the selected period are processed. Once processing is complete, these values are the authoritative measure of credits consumed.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness starts charging credits during building, before publication.
claims.quote: Unlike the standard harness, which starts billing after publish, the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Previewing, testing and creating evaluations for Microsoft Copilot harness agents consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Experiences such as creating an automated solution with natural language, previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.claim: Makers can use the Preview credit figure to compare how prompts, knowledge sources and tools affect consumption before publishing.
claims.quote: This feature helps you understand how different prompts, instructions, knowledge sources, and tools affect consumption before you publish your agent.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the roadmap display is on by default for every maker.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Preview History credit estimate display default enabled disable setting admin maker cost visibility 571194. Read roadmap, Preview overview, Preview history and Understand estimated credit usage; no rollout default for every maker stated.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No admin or maker switch for the cost display itself is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Preview History credit estimate display default enabled disable setting admin maker cost visibility 571194; "Copilot Studio" "credit" "display" "disable" "Power Platform API". Read Preview overview, Preview history and credit-display documentation; no switch found.

claims.claim: The credit display is an estimate for planning, not a spending cap.
claims.quote: Whenever a credit value is an estimate, the user interface includes an information icon and an explanatory message indicating that the value is intended for planning purposes and will be finalized later.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Environment credit allocations govern the prepaid consumption described in the briefing.
claims.quote: To contain prepaid consumption, allocate a defined amount of Copilot Credits to the environment and turn off **Draw from the available capacity in my tenant**.
claims.fix: Qualify the allocation guidance and row note with: 'These Power Platform controls apply while spending remains managed in the Power Platform admin center. If a Microsoft 365 admin center resource-based spending policy covers the environment, its spending policy takes precedence and the Power Platform capacity allocations and linked billing plans do not apply.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-studio-costs, which documents this exception to the cited Power Platform guidance.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Clearing Draw from the available capacity in my tenant prevents drawing unallocated tenant prepaid capacity after the allocation is consumed.
claims.quote: When you clear this option, the environment doesn't draw from unallocated prepaid capacity in the tenant after it consumes its allocation.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling tenant prepaid draw does not stop usage through a linked pay-as-you-go billing plan.
claims.quote: If the environment is linked to a pay-as-you-go billing plan, usage can continue through the linked Azure subscription.

claims.claim: When no credits are available, credit-dependent experiences can stop working for makers and end users.
claims.quote: When an environment has no available Copilot Credits, experiences that require credits can stop working. This limitation can affect both makers and end users.

claims.claim: History shows credit estimates alongside conversation details including status, steps and duration.
claims.quote:
**Steps/Turns** | The number of processing steps and conversation turns
**Duration** | How long the conversation lasted
**Credits used** | The estimated Copilot Credits used during the session.

claims.claim: The cited credit-display pages describe no new data source for the agent to access.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Preview History credit estimate display default enabled disable setting admin maker cost visibility 571194. Opened Preview overview, Preview history and Understand estimated credit usage; they describe displaying usage estimates, not adding agent data access.

claims.claim: History already contains full test-conversation message histories.
claims.quote:
In the history view, select a conversation to open its details.
Review the full message history, including user messages and agent responses.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Credits are charged to the running environment's prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go plan, not to the individual maker or user.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan, and not to the individual makers or users who run agents.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not state which makers can see another maker's History credit figures.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Preview History Credits used conversation history access other makers shared agents permissions; "Copilot Studio" "History" "other makers" "credits". Read Preview history and sharing-page search excerpts; neither specifies cross-maker History credit visibility.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap change is cost visibility for makers rather than a change to agent actions.
claims.quote: Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

claims.claim: Learn describes a delay of a few hours before final credit numbers appear in Monitor.
claims.quote: Those events are then processed, and the final, accurate number is reflected in **Monitor** within a few hours.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not describe the cost display as having its own licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History licensing price display rollout release channel 571194. Opened Preview overview, Preview history, Understand estimated credit usage, billing overview and cost management; no display-specific licence stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness agents use consumption-based billing measured in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use consumption-based billing. Building, testing, evaluating, and running these agents can consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: A user's Microsoft 365 Copilot licence does not include Microsoft Copilot harness agent usage.
claims.quote: This usage isn't included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft lists Microsoft Copilot harness agents as billed for all usage regardless of the user's licence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot harness agents | No | Billed for all usage. Creation and runtime activities consume Copilot Credits regardless of the user's license.

claims.claim: Developer and trial environments move to usage-based billing on 1 September 2026.
claims.quote: Developer environments and trial environments move to usage-based billing September 1, 2026.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No rate or charge specific to displaying the estimates is published in the documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History licensing price display rollout release channel 571194. Read Preview overview, Preview history, credit-display documentation, billing overview and cost management; no display-specific rate or charge found.

claims.claim: The Preview and History pages describe agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.quote: The **Preview** tab in agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness in Microsoft Copilot Studio maintains a history of your test conversations.

claims.claim: The History page lists an agent created with the Microsoft Copilot harness as a prerequisite.
claims.quote:
## Prerequisites
- An agent created with the Microsoft Copilot harness
- At least one test conversation in the **Preview** tab

claims.claim: Learn does not specify the rollout mechanism for roadmap item 571194 itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History licensing price display rollout release channel 571194; "571194" "Preview". Read Preview overview, Preview history and credit-display documentation; no roadmap-specific rollout mechanism found.

claims.claim: Learn does not specify a release channel for the roadmap item itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History licensing price display rollout release channel 571194. Opened Preview overview, Preview history and Understand estimated credit usage; no item-specific release channel stated.

claims.claim: Learn does not specify a licence prerequisite for roadmap item 571194 itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History licensing price display rollout release channel 571194. Read Preview overview, Preview history, billing overview and cost management; platform billing is documented, but no licence prerequisite is attributed to this roadmap item.

claims.claim: Managing credit allocations requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the **Power Platform Administrator** or **Global Administrator** role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Environment allocation management is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select **Licensing**.
Under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio**, and then select **Manage Copilot Credits**.
Select the environment that you want to manage.

claims.claim: The allocation request uses PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 with bearer authentication and an application/json body.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: The tenant-draw checkbox is under Capacity overages after selecting the environment in Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Under **Capacity overages**, select or clear **Draw from the available capacity in my tenant** to control what happens when the environment exhausts its allocation

claims.claim: The allocation JSON names scope.environmentId, the MCSMessages entitlement, allocation.quantity and enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled false.
Power Platform admin center supports an agent-level monthly Copilot Credit limit.
claims.quote:
Select the agent, and then select **Set limit**.
Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits have a configurable notification threshold.
claims.quote: Configure the notification threshold.

claims.claim: The agent limit offers Stop usage to turn the agent off when it reaches the limit.
claims.quote: Turn on **Stop usage** if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: The agent monthly-limit path is Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote:
In the Power Platform admin center, go to **Licensing** > **Copilot Studio**.
Select **Manage Agents**.
Select the agent, and then select **Set limit**.

claims.claim: A published environment group rule governing tenant draw causes attempted environment-level UI or API updates to be rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the `TenantPoolLockedByPolicy` error.

claims.claim: The allocation operation governs capacity and tenant draw rather than whether credit estimates are displayed.
claims.quote:
the `allocationsV2` operation writes an environment's allocation.
The **Draw from the available capacity in my tenant** option in the admin center maps to the `TenantPool` enforcement rule

claims.claim: The variable cost rating reflects metered Copilot Credit consumption for the harness testing described, rather than an asserted separate display charge.
claims.quote: Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits.
